description: Compare a whole region with one command; good for checking whether a student build matches a reference. Comparing block by block hits the MCP host timeout beyond a few hundred blocks; this does not. masked=true ignores air in the source region and only checks that what should be there is there, regardless of anything extra around it; masked=false requires an exact match. Both regions must be the same size; destination is the minimum corner of the target region.

begin.description: One corner of the source region

mode.description: absolute = world coordinates; relative = ~ relative to the command source; local = ^ relative to its facing

destination.description: Minimum corner of the target region

mode.description: absolute = world coordinates; relative = ~ relative to the command source; local = ^ relative to its facing

end.description: The opposite corner of the source region

mode.description: absolute = world coordinates; relative = ~ relative to the command source; local = ^ relative to its facing

masked.description: When true, air in the source is ignored

name: mc_compare_regions
title: Compare two regions of equal size
